messages:
Avery Chen: Quick idea I sketched this morning — introduce a lightweight saved "slate" for per-route analytics/views. Slate = (filter set, pinned model variant, display layout, optional quota/preview hint). Goal: let product teams switch context rapidly per-route without creating heavyweight savedviews.

Samir Patel: Sounds promising. Main concerns: ownership/ACL (who can create/pin a slate as the route default) and how this surfaces in cost/telemetry.

Lena Morales: UX notes: compact pill next to route name -> dropdown of slates + small preview. Save button should have two modes: "Save for me" and "Save as route default". Hover tooltip shows estimated token burn and last-run sample metrics. Minimal flows: quick-switch, ephemeral preview, commit.

Rajiv Kapoor: From API/runtime side we need a small contract extension. Proposal: attach slate_id and slate_fallbacks to RouteConfig. Creating a slate should be a separate resource: POST /api/v1/slates {name, route_id?, config: {filters, model_pin, layout}}. When slate is pinned as default, route metadata points to slate_id. Fallback order can be [route default -> team default -> global default].

Morgan (telemetry): Telemetry must include `slate_id` and `slate_origin` (user | team | route-default | system). Also log `pinned_model` and `preview_sample_rate`. Caveat: adding `slate_id` increases tag cardinality. Suggest: keep slate_id and origin on sampled traces (1-5% by default) and emit aggregated counters per-slate hourly for billing/usage. Also add a flag `ui_preview=true` when the preview panel was used (so we don't mistake previews for real traffic).

Priya Nguyen: Security/legal: changes that affect routing (model_pin) are sensitive. Only users with route-write or a specific "slate-pin" permission should be able to set route defaults. All pin actions must generate audit events with before/after. If a slate references a model variant that isn't allowed for the tenant, reject at creation time.

Samir Patel: Rollout idea: create slate support behind a feature flag for the console and API. Canary on 5% of routes for 2 weeks, measure: avg latency, token burn delta, model fallback rate, and support tickets. If rollout passes, allow 100% and expose ACL to org admins.

Avery Chen: Example payloads I mocked for API + telemetry: 

API - create slate (POST /api/v1/slates):
```
{
  "name": "Compact Gen + Safety Filters",
  "route_id": "route_abc123",
  "config": {
    "filters": {"nlp_tag": "support", "min_length": 30},
    "model_pin": "redwood/gpt-3.5-qdq",
    "layout": "compact"
  },
  "visibility": "team"
}
```

Telemetry event (sampled):
```
{
  "event": "request_processed",
  "slate_id": "sl_987",
  "slate_origin": "team",
  "pinned_model": "redwood/gpt-3.5-qdq",
  "ui_preview": false,
  "sample_rate": 0.02
}
```

Rajiv Kapoor: Implementation notes: keep slate resolution asynchronous in routing path — resolve slate_id -> config cached for 60s, fallback to route config if the slate lookup fails. Avoid blocking inference path on DB reads. Also add a small validation step when pinning (pre-warm model route capacity check).

Morgan (telemetry): Also suggest a telemetry aggregate endpoint: GET /internal/telemetry/slates/summary?since=24h which returns counts and median latencies per-slate (pre-aggregated hourly) so analytics can show quick cost previews without overloading raw events.

Priya Nguyen: Add audit log events: `slate.create`, `slate.update`, `slate.pin`, `slate.unpin`. These must include actor, timestamp, route_id, old_slate, new_slate.

Samir Patel: UX rollout: initial MVP should only expose "Save for me" + preview. After canary, unlock "Save as route default" for admins. Keep a visible banner for pinned default ("Route default slate: Compact Gen + Safety Filters — pinned by @Avery Chen on 2025-10-02").

rollout-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: slate-feature -> 5% routes -> start 2025-11-05T18:00Z -> metrics job: slate.canary.health. Auto-rollback threshold: >2% increase in median latency or >3% cost delta vs baseline.

Avery Chen: Action items:
- Lena: prototype compact pill + preview (mock by 2025-10-09)
- Rajiv: add slate resource + cached resolution + validation (RFC + PR by 2025-10-16)
- Morgan: proto telemetry schema + aggregate endpoint (sampling guidance) (by 2025-10-12)
- Priya: ACL/audit spec (by 2025-10-12)
- Samir: write rollout plan & SLOs (by 2025-10-14)

Lena Morales: acked, will sketch interaction + small accessibility note for dropdown nav.

Rajiv Kapoor: dropping a small example for RouteConfig patch: `PATCH /api/v1/routes/route_abc123 {"default_slate_id":"sl_987"}` — we'll gate to org admins.

Avery Chen: OK great. We'll sync in the design sprint tomorrow 10:30. 

Samir Patel: thanks everyone — will follow up with tasks in the board. :thumbsup:
